claims: U.S. stock markets (NYSE and Nasdaq) are closed on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.
U.S. stock markets will reopen on Monday, April 6, 2026, at 9:30 a.m. ET.
The U.S. bond market will have an early closure at noon ET on Friday, April 3, 2026.
Most major banks will be open for regular business on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.
USPS will operate as normal on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.
London and Paris exchanges are closed on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.
Tokyo and Shanghai markets remain open on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.
The next scheduled stock market holiday is Memorial Day on Monday, May 25, 2026.
